Alex / Priya — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and a proposed Mutual Action Plan (attached) so we have a single source of truth for milestones and owners. Highlights: 

- Target close: 2027-04-15 (proposed) — this assumes standard PO + legal review cadence.
- Key milestones and owners (proposed):
  • Procurement kickoff (Priya) — 3/12
  • Legal review complete (Zephyra legal + Redwood legal) — 3/25
  • Exec approval / PO issuance (Alex) — 4/05
  • Signature / DocuSign complete — 4/15
- Dependencies: acceptance of RW standard Addendum (we noted one minor question around data retention), internal budget window at Zephyra, and PO lead time.

Please review the attached "MAP-Zephyra-Draft-v1.xlsx" (stated milestones and acceptance criteria) and confirm: (1) procurement owner and their preferred internal deadline, (2) whether legal redlines are expected beyond the standard addendum, and (3) if the proposed target close (4/15) is workable.

If 4/15 is aggressive for you, call it out and propose an ideal signature date and the blockers we should map. I can turn this into v2 and re-run with legal.

Thanks — I’ll schedule a 30-minute alignment on Thursday to lock owners unless you prefer earlier.

Vanessa — appreciate the clear recap. Two quick notes from procurement side: 

1) Signature runway: Zephyra is trying to land signature by 2027-04-01 to align with Q1 vendor close. Can Redwood meet that if we compress the milestones?
2) Procurement owner: Priya Singh will lead on our side (cc’d). Priya — our internal checklist requires legal redlines in by 3/18 to hit a 4/1 signature. 

We attached our procurement checklist (Zeph_Procurement_Checklist.pdf) — it calls out: PO release timeline, completion of SOC2 review (already in progress), and headcount-related budget approval. If Redwood can shorten legal turnaround to ~5 business days, we should be able to make 4/1.

Happy to take the MAP v2 and mark dates on our calendar. For the 30-minute alignment, Thu is fine but earlier Wed afternoon would be better for the procurement and legal folks.

- Redwood legal confirmed we can target finalized SOW signature by 2027-03-24 for standard addendum acceptances, or by 2027-03-29 if there are 1-2 substantive redlines. Anything beyond a handful of redlines will likely add another 3 business days.
- Action items for sales to secure 4/01 signature target:
  1) Ask Zephyra to supply final redlines no later than 2027-03-18 (Priya lead).
  2) Confirm exec approver name and expected PO issuance date. If PO issuance slips past 3/29 we risk missing 4/01.
  3) If available, provide any procurement-approved template language now so legal can pre-clear.

Operational suggestion: offer a short 14-day payment net on the initial invoice as a small commercial concession to encourage earlier PO release if budget cycles are tight — this helps close by 4/01 without changing core contract terms. 

If you want, I can pre-populate the DocuSign envelope and route to our signing exec once we have final redlines — send me the final doc and I'll start the workflow.
